steps: Enroll in a free LinkedIn Learning course on Microsoft Office 365 basics (Word, Outlook, Excel).
Practice calendar management by scheduling mock meetings and setting reminders in Outlook.
Take a short online course on record-keeping and documentation best practices (e.g., Coursera's 'Records Management').
Volunteer or shadow a Teaching Assistant to gain hands-on experience with attendance and classroom support.
Research and apply for child abuse clearance (e.g., PA Child Abuse History Clearance) to meet certification requirements.
